Two differentiations give P''(0)=uv(aq-bp)^2/(pu+qv)^3, with Cassini determinant ±1. The asymptotic root limit and cover plateaus prove the sharp C and entire interval. Finite graph and pressure checks passed; their finite scope is acknowledged.

value.rationale: The variance of symbol-frequency Birkhoff sums is a natural invariant for ergodic finite-type approximations. Unlike the known entropy rate of order \(F_k^{-1}\), the fluctuation variance decays at the sharp and provably nonzero rate \(F_k^{-3}\). Exact constant 0.517496... and complete nontrivial rescaled interval quantify suppression and discrete-scale oscillations in approximating an aperiodic uniquely ergodic system; this is not an arbitrary parameter slice or a simple reexpression of topological entropy.
